intended_behavior: Implement a method to list all keys (record IDs) present in the specified memory table. The method should return keys without leaking raw data and preserve existing data structures and behaviors.
Confirm or extend this method to support adding files to the memory, ensuring compatibility with file-based operations alongside existing functionality.
Confirm or extend this method to support removing files from the memory, ensuring compatibility with file-based operations alongside existing functionality.

Implement CLI subcommands using click for listing keys in memory, adding files, and removing files from memory. Each command should invoke corresponding methods in mle/utils/memory.py and integrate well with the existing CLI setup while maintaining prior functionality.
